title: iyzitrace · Operation Dependencies
description: Operation-level call dependencies derived from iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total. Shows EXACTLY which client RPC method/HTTP route calls which server operation — far more granular than service-to-service dependency views. Includes req/sec, error rate, and latency per pair, plus a pipeline DAG view for selected services.

list.name: service
list.label: Focus service
list.description: Pick a service to scope the pipeline DAG and BFS-filter the Sankey to its reachable downstream subgraph. Other panels always show the full graph.

panels.title: Operation pairs
panels.description: Distinct (client, server, client_op, server_op) edges. Fine granularity. The 'gain' from operation-level visibility.

targets.expr: topk(1, sum by (client, server, client_operation_name, server_operation_name) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Sankey · operation pairs (flow + error tint)
panels.description: client.op → server.op flow. Width = req/sec. Red tint = failed edges. Pick a Focus service to BFS-filter to its reachable downstream subgraph.

targets.expr: sum by (client, server, client_operation_name, server_operation_name, failed) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total[$__rate_interval])) > ${min_rps}

panels.title: Pipeline DAG · downstream operation chain from focus service
panels.description: Layered DAG layout. BFS levels left→right. Each box is a service.operation. Edge color = error rate, edge width hint = req/sec. Pick a Focus service to root the pipeline. With 'All' selected, picks the highest-traffic root.

targets.expr: sum by (client, server, client_operation_name, server_operation_name, failed) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total[$__rate_interval])) > ${min_rps}

panels.title: Operation pair adjacency matrix
panels.description: Heatmap with client.op on Y axis and server.op on X axis. Cell color = req/sec. Hover for error rate. Empty cells = no traffic.

targets.expr: sum by (client, server, client_operation_name, server_operation_name) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_failed_total[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (client, server, client_operation_name, server_operation_name) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Top 10 operation pairs by error rate
panels.description: Sorted by failed/sec / total/sec. Lower-than-min-traffic pairs may be excluded by the min_rps variable.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (client, client_operation_name, server, server_operation_name) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_failed_total[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (client, client_operation_name, server, server_operation_name) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9))

panels.title: Every operation pair — req/s, error %, client p95, server p95
panels.description: Sortable. Click any column header. The complete operation-level dependency catalog.

targets.expr: sum by (client, client_operation_name, server, server_operation_name) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_failed_total[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (client, client_operation_name, server, server_operation_name) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (client, client_operation_name, server, server_operation_name, le) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_client_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (client, client_operation_name, server, server_operation_name, le) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_server_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))
